firstLines: Daniel Okafor
Atlanta, GA | (404) 555-0176 | daniel.okafor@example.com | linkedin.com/in/danielokafor
SUMMARY
Supply chain manager with seven years in distribution and inbound logistics for home goods and grocery. Known for
fixing carrier performance, cutting freight spend and building simple reports that warehouse teams actually read.
EXPERIENCE
Red Clay Hearth Home Goods Atlanta, GA
Supply Chain Manager Feb 2022 – Present
• Manage inbound freight for 3 distribution centers and a team of 6 planners, about $48M in annual spend
• Renegotiated contracts with 9 truckload carriers, saving $2.1M a year while raising on-time delivery from 87% to
• Set up a weekly carrier scorecard in Power BI that the VP of Operations reviews with every carrier each quarter
• Led the move from spreadsheets to a cloud TMS with no missed shipments during the two-week cutover
Brassmoor Freight Systems Atlanta, GA
Senior Logistics Analyst Apr 2020 – Jan 2022
• Modeled lane costs for 120 shipping lanes and recommended 14 consolidations that saved $640K in the first
year
• Built an SQL dashboard on detention charges that helped recover $210K in disputed fees from shippers
• Trained four analysts on the costing model and wrote the handbook the team still uses
Brassmoor Freight Systems Atlanta, GA
Logistics Analyst Jun 2018 – Mar 2020
• Tracked daily load status for 300 shipments and flagged delays to customer service before customers called
• Automated the weekly fuel surcharge report in Excel VBA, saving about 5 hours each week
Gorseholt Distribution Macon, GA
Operations Coordinator Jul 2017 – May 2018
• Scheduled dock appointments for 60 inbound trucks a day and cut average wait time from 2 hours to 40 minutes
• Ran cycle counts with the inventory team, raising location accuracy from 92% to 98.5%
EDUCATION
Pinemoor University Columbus, GA
Bachelor of Business Administration in Supply Chain Management May 2017
